title: Extract a labeled user name
prompt: Accept a string beginning exactly with "user:" followed by a nonempty name. Return the name. Reject other prefixes and empty names with std::invalid_argument. A colon inside the name is ordinary text.

tests.label: Simple record
tests.hint: Take the substring after the label.

tests.label: Colon in name
tests.hint: Only the fixed leading label is special.

tests.label: Empty name
tests.hint: The name must not be empty.

hints: starts_with checks the exact first five characters.
After validation, substr(5) views characters from index 5 onward.
explanation: string_view borrows the caller’s text; constructing std::string makes a returned owner that remains valid after the caller changes.
